replies.body: Ok thanks, I'll make a proper appeal. If there's any more reply to me and I'll change it.<br id="null"><br id="null">1. The clip on Wahiz: From what I've seen in the video, it's nothing but a visual glitch. On occasions you might see someone eating a gapple while sprinting, as long as they don't get the effects from it after they eat it, it's just a visual glitch. There's also sometimes a glitch where you sprint with your head facing the wrong way (I'll update the reply with a yt link if I can find a video with something like that). Although some of this may not be a visual glitch, I play on a high sensitivity some of the time on Avicus, and the clip is either a visual glitch, or me simply twitching my mouse to hit the person fighting me, then missing, and trying to twitch again. As I flew towards the void I twitched my mouse to the side so I could try to land on the surface. Also this clip doesn't really seem like Aim Assist, which is what I was banned for, but it's your opinion. Also when I was talking about visual glitches, I mean't when I first went to fight whoever was hitting me, then the glitch happened causing my head to be spun around, since I was twitching my mouse to the side, and MC glitched it.<br id="null"><br id="null">2. Clip of me on Supply: All I did was hit DC, he got hit by Budah, I spun around to try to hit him, but he got hit in front of me again so I had to spin around and Budah just happened to be in my face when I did. I slowed the clip down, watched it again, and I didn't see much that was suspicious except when he got hit while he was inside me, but I didn't hit him, as you can see Ingigo hits him while he's inside me on my screen, since Minecraft doesn't render the players in the exact pixel that they are on for everyone at the same time, Ingigo was able to hit him since he was on a different pixel on his screen then it was on mine (if you lag a lot, the players freeze so they're on different areas then some other people, Ingigo was lagging at the time since Britain doesn't get the same MS and latency as me [US]).<br id="null"><br id="null"><br id="null">3. It's not a common tactic, but there have been videos where people have done the same thing. This clip is convincing, but it probably wouldn't if I didn't die, so it would have showed you that it's not cheating, just simply me trying to win a 2v1.<br id="null"><br id="null"><br id="null">EDIT: I also was SS'ed for an hour and 15 mins, and came out clean. replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Firstly, you're going to have to tell me/convince me a bit better than just saying what happened... That doesn't prove anything or achieve anything. I've got video evidence of you so I can see what's happening.

Ok about your first point.

 The clip on Wahiz: From what I've seen in the video, it's nothing but a visual glitch. On occasions you might see someone eating a gapple while sprinting, as long as they don't get the effects from it after they eat it, it's just a visual glitch.
I'm not sure what point your trying to make there? You're banned for Aim Assist, not noslowdown. If there was indeed a point at which there was that glitch, that wasn't the reason why we banned you and we know that most of the time it's a visual glitch.

 There's also sometimes a glitch where you sprint with your head facing the wrong way (I'll update the reply with a yt link if I can find a video with something like that).
Any luck finding a youtube video of that happening on Minecraft 1.8 or even better, Avicus?

My points regarding clip #1:
- Your head snaps to each player but furthermore when Rilo comes into a certain range you snap to him and then almost instantly snap back to Stimulating, or whoever it was recorded by. This is typical of an aim assist, it will snap back and fourth. 
- I highly doubt you were twitching purposely, I'm sure it's possible but, there is a difference between a head twitch and a snap. Head twitches are often inaccurate as you're just trying to make it look sketchy, snaps are accurate as well, it auto aims or assists your aim onto the closest person.

Now, onto your second point.

Some of those hits obviously are definitely possible and I'm pretty sure you're more than capable or pulling some of them off. In this clip, there isn't much new evidence that we can add to the pool, it's just a small bit here and there that kind of supports the punishment. You managed to hit quite a few of your teammates, which some could argue could be due to an aim assist, but I'm not specifically interested in that part specifically. I'm interested in 0:17, go to that part and turn it down to 0.25. You can see your crosshair is directed towards blaze, but more specifically, when blaze dies, your crosshair follows his body up to when it disappears and he's in the center of your crosshair. This is also typical of an aim assist. 

I also talked to Stimulating about that part specifically because I wanted to get his opinion on it. He brought up a good point, at 0:17 you have been given knockback by one of the players behind you, meaning you couldn't predict the kb dealt and despite this, your crosshair still follows blaze. The second the knockback is dealt to you, your aim corrects itself, which I highly doubt is possible. 

Lastly point 3:

 but there have been videos where people have done the same thing.
Would you have any you could link me?

This one is probably the hardest out of all of them to prove. It's pretty much legit, anyone could do that. But the thing that caught my attention was the way you snapped to Hete and then back to Stimulating. Not much to explain about that to be honest, just your typical head snapping, but like I said above, if you have any evidence or videos of someone doing that, in a first person view would be preferred, then that might help your cause. 

Regarding your screenshare
Your screenshare isn't really a valid point at all. Since it went for so long, it was obvious that we found some suspicious stuff but at the time we didn't know enough about them. We ended up letting you go because you had a match and your team needed you to play and because one of the Officials was busy and didn't want to deal with you, so we couldn't look into it further. However, we did say, and I specifically remember saying this, that we would go away and do some research into some of the stuff we found and if we found that anything wasn't what it should have been then it would be used against you in a later scenario. We did some research into all of it, and well, failing a java test, missing 3 java apps and your version opening two versions at the same time, isn't going to be a valid point at all.

Sorry I haven't replied in a week or two, anyways here's my argument.


Regarding Clip One: I really don't see how this is hacks, I'm simply spinning my mouse, I don't even hit him. Also this isn't even suspicious to what I was banned for.

Regarding Clip Two: Yes, this clip looks sketchy, but all I am actually doing is rotating my mouse in a circle. I feel that you are really over complicating this clip, especially since this a team fight and team fights are very chaotic and it's hard to know who to aim at.

replies.author: Seuthy
replies.body:
Sorry I haven't been motivated to appeal.
Regarding the second point I honestly don't understand what more you want. Literally this wasn't even a lock on and I moved my mouse to kill LFT when Blaze died and his body went to the right, which is a complete coincidence in where I was aiming. Not to mention, if you slow the video down, I hit Blaze on his head and midsection before he dies. An aim assist doesn't lock on to several parts of the body, it only locks on to one, and that is the one you first hit. Since I first hit Blaze's head, it should have locked on there. If not there, then at his midsection. You then talk about how I jump up, get hit, and aim downwards. This is more proof of me not cheating, because if I had aim assist, it would not have propelled my aim all the way down to his toes, it would have locked on, to the original place where I was hitting Blaze, his head or midsection.  I have a video of me using actual aim assist on a private server with permission that shows that the cheat doesn't even lock on to your feet. It locks on to your head, or sometimes the first part of the body you hit (I was not using the most advanced aim assist). If you think this client was "what I used in the evidence" then I honestly don't even understand anymore....  You can see a WolfRAM tag in the top left corner and in mine there is not one so that's just beyond stupid to believe that.
(this was on the new Cronus server so you can't say that it was old footage because they got a new server)
Also just to mention the movement with the aim assist is very choppy and in my evidence video my aim is not choppy,

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abN8_lHwiTc
READ THE DESC OF THE VIDEO (PLEASE)

Also, you wrote this, "Your crosshair followed blaze through until you killed him, even moving directly with Blazes dead body. Your aim doesn't change because of the knockback, it's clear that you've either physically moved your mouse within the space of a split second, without even seeing/judging the knockback dealt to you, or an Aim Assist, which it does look like. There is no way the knockback caused your aim to go from the top of blazes head to the toes on his feet.

Regarding that, of course my crosshair followed him through, since I was trying to kill him. "Even moving directly with Blazes dead body" I have no other way to say this. It was a coincidence. Of course it will move with his body if his body fell to the right when he died, and that is the exact same way LFT got hit? I was trying to kill LFT, and Blazes body got in the way, to cause it to look sketchy. Simple as that. I've found a clip of basically the same thing that happened in this video: https://youtu.be/7mPaJCYBbww?t=3m45s Slow it down, Stimpay doesn't use aim assist or any other cheat, so this can also be described as a coincidence. His crosshair follows NoRiskk's body until his body vanishes, like mine. Surely I'm not the only one who can do this, and I'll try to find more videos.
Also, bolding is broken and I have no clue how to fix it, so there. If you can edit it that would be cool l0l

READ THE DESC OF THE VIDEO (PLEASE)

Regarding that, of course my crosshair followed him through, since I was trying to kill him. "Even moving directly with Blazes dead body" I have no other way to say this. It was a coincidence. Of course it will move with his body if his body fell to the right when he died, and that is the exact same way LFT got hit? I was trying to kill LFT, and Blazes body got in the way, to cause it to look sketchy. Simple as that. His crosshair follows NoRiskk's body until his body vanishes, like mine. Surely I'm not the only one who can do this, and I'll try to find more videos.

I'm going to ignore what you said before for now, I want to try and clear up the part where I "lock on" to his feet. I believe I've said this in my previous arguments, and the part about me locking on to his feet was just from when I jumped, and got hit. No time at all in that fight did I lock on to his chest, other than when he died and I moved my crosshair over and down to hit LFT.
